scientific_integrity: The results are derived with an explicit combinatorial bijection and independent finite checks. Claims of priority remain qualified by the stated literature search. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Valid for a fixed finite alphabet with compulsory lower gaps and no upper gap restriction; does not handle bounded upper gaps or pattern-specific enumeration. Computational checks are finite corroboration, not the basis of the infinite proof. Closely related classical zero-gap enumeration could hide an unindexed earlier equivalent reduction.
title: Exact enumeration and renewal law for lower-gap subsequence universality
